title: A Mpemba "crossing" that the metric could not test: an audit of an earlier analysis and a pre-specified re-analysis of a double-well Langevin model
description:
Code, tests, tables and a draft correction note for a re-analysis of a claimed Mpemba-like crossing in an overdamped Langevin double-well model. The earlier draft's detector did not apply its own initial-ordering condition; a pre-specified, validated one-dimensional Fokker–Planck re-analysis shows a crossing that is a known, largely design-determined mechanism (not a new result).

Status: draft, not peer reviewed; no independent human replication. The work was done with AI assistance (see the note's disclosure). Start with REPRODUCE.md and paper/note_v2_draft.md. The public git history was rewritten once on 2026-09-29 (see HISTORY_REWRITE.md).
